description: Header file defining the SkiaCapture class, which manages frame capturing and serialization for Skia rendering in Android's Render Engine.

classes.name: SkiaCapture
classes.description: Manages frame capture, recording, and serialization for Skia rendering, including multi-frame capture and offscreen support.

methods.name: tryCapture
methods.description: Attempts to capture the current frame; returns a SkCanvas for recording commands.

methods.name: tryOffscreenCapture
methods.description: Performs offscreen capture with provided surface and state.

methods.name: endOffscreenCapture
methods.description: Finalizes offscreen capture and serializes data.
